hook: Nvidia's CEO search, agent wallets, a Cybercab and Gödel
summary: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's Rene Haas to succeed Jensen Huang, as staff petition for Huang's return.
OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets agents buy for users, while Amazon drafts a World Product Graph covering products across the web.
Tesla opens Cybercab orders for personal use at $29,990, and Claude helped researchers read 1,009 pages of Gödel's shorthand notes.

stories.headline: Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has approached Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO. Meanwhile, a petition by Nvidia employees to reinstate Huang has received backing from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.
stories.why_it_matters: The leadership transition at Nvidia marks a significant change for the chipmaker that supplies leading artificial intelligence chips globally.
source_titles: Nvidia approaches Arm Holdings CEO Haas to take over Jensen Huang's job, Elon Musk backs Huang's reinstatement
Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return, media reports say
stories.line: Nvidia board reportedly courts Arm's Rene Haas to succeed Jensen Huang
stories.detail: Staff are petitioning to reinstate Huang after his resignation, and Elon Musk has backed them.
stories.image_prompt: A close-up of a glowing computer chip on a circuit board, cool blue light, shallow depth of field, no text, logos or people.
stories.anchor: We start at Nvidia. Jensen Huang has quit the top job at the maker of the world's leading AI chips, and many employees want him back.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
stories.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, a new payment feature that lets its "dots" AI agents make purchases on behalf of users. The feature is initially available to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers ages 18 and older.
stories.why_it_matters: This launch expands the ability of AI agents to handle real-world transactions directly on behalf of consumers using secure payment tokens.
source_titles: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
OpenAI announces ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its dots AI agents make purchases on behalf of users, available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are over 18 (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, enabling ‘dot’ agents to make purchases
OpenAI’s ChatGPT Wallet lets its AI agents shop without seeing your card
stories.line: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet lets its agents pay at checkout
stories.detail: First available to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and over.
stories.image_prompt: A smartphone beside a payment card and an abstract shopping cart icon glowing on a desk, soft studio light, no text, logos or people.
stories.anchor: OpenAI's dots agents can now pay for things themselves, using secure payment tokens, so the AI can finish the shopping it starts.

stories.headline: Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents
stories.summary: Amazon has drafted a plan called the World Product Graph to gather information on every product sold across the internet, including by crawling rival websites. The project aims to improve Amazon's AI search accuracy and ensure AI shopping agents rely on its data index.
stories.why_it_matters: As AI shopping agents gain popularity, tech platforms are competing to control the underlying product data that these bots rely on to make purchasing decisions.
source_titles: Doc: Amazon, wary of AI agents favoring sites with better data, plans to gather data on nearly every product sold anywhere, including by crawling rivals' sites (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
Amazon's plan to own the world's product data and fight AI shopping agents
stories.line: Amazon drafts a plan to map every product sold online
stories.detail: The World Product Graph would include crawling rival sites to sharpen Amazon's AI search.
stories.image_prompt: Rows of warehouse shelves stacked with parcels, linked by glowing network lines overhead, no text, logos or people.
stories.anchor: Meanwhile, Amazon wants to be the index those shopping bots trust, as platforms race to own the product data agents rely on.

stories.headline: Tesla invites select customers to order Cybercab for personal use
stories.summary: Tesla is offering select customers the ability to order its driverless Cybercab for personal use at a price of $29,990. Operating the vehicle requires a mandatory $299 per month Autonomy Subscription and is limited to supported service areas in Texas and Florida.
stories.why_it_matters: This marks a step toward making consumer-owned, driverless vehicles available to the public, though usage is currently restricted by geographic geofences and mandatory recurring software fees.
source_titles: Tesla says "select customers" can now place orders for its Cybercab "for personal use", for $30K plus a required $299/month Autonomy Subscription to operate (Kara Carlson/Bloomberg)
Tesla Starts Taking Cybercab Orders From Select Customers
Tesla Cybercab orders open at $29,990 + $299/mo, only in Robotaxi zones
Tesla Opens Self-Driving Cybercab Orders To 'Select Customers' At $29,990
Tesla opens sales of autonomous Cybercab for 'select' customers
stories.line: Tesla opens Cybercab orders to select buyers for private use
stories.detail: $29,990, plus a required $299-a-month Autonomy Subscription to run it.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek driverless two-seat car parked on a sunny suburban street at golden hour, no text, logos or people.
stories.anchor: Tesla is letting some customers own a driverless car, though it only runs inside supported zones in Texas and Florida.

stories.headline: AI unlocks Kurt Gödel's notebooks to reveal hundreds of proved theorems
stories.summary: Researchers used the AI model Claude to analyze 1,009 pages of Kurt Gödel's 1940s notebooks written in obsolete German shorthand. The AI processed the material within days, revealing hundreds of proved theorems and mathematical discoveries.
stories.why_it_matters: The application demonstrates how large language models can decode obsolete shorthand and process complex historical manuscripts to accelerate academic research.
source_titles: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems
AI unlocks 80-year-old secrets of Einstein's friend, uncovers hundreds of mathematical discoveries
stories.line: Claude helps decode Kurt Gödel's 1940s shorthand notebooks
stories.detail: 1,009 pages in obsolete German shorthand, processed within days, with hundreds of proofs found.
stories.image_prompt: An old open notebook filled with dense illegible pencil scribbles on a wooden desk under a warm lamp, no readable text or people.
stories.anchor: Finally, researchers used Anthropic's Claude on Gödel's notes in long-obsolete German shorthand, and it surfaced hundreds of proved theorems.
